# Mira story map

## Released

- S1 A shop owner sees today's report on the kiosk.

## Next release

- S2 A shop owner downloads the report as a CSV file.

## Deferred (not in the release plan)

- S9 A shop owner invites a second manager.
- S10 A shop owner downloads the report as an XLSX file (requested by Haruto, TASK-016). Blocked by ADR 0011 (CSV only) until Mira supersedes it.

# TASK-016 XLSX export request

Status: ready

Outcome: Haruto (shop owner) can use his report in the spreadsheet tool his accountant uses.

## Notes

- Haruto asked for "an Excel file instead of CSV".

## Decision (2026-10-21)

- Kept as is: no XLSX export. ADR 0011 (docs/adr/0011-reports-are-exported-as-csv-only.md, Accepted) says CSV only until a newer record supersedes it.
- Mira's message was "Haruto is a good customer, so please make him happy." That is goodwill, not a decision to change ADR 0011 or to add XLSX, so it does not supersede the ruling.
- Haruto's accountant's tool can usually open CSV; this is untested. Mira can reply to Haruto on that basis.
- To get XLSX, Mira must supersede ADR 0011 with a new record. The request is parked in the story map as S10.
